title: GitHub Copilot CRUSHES Leetcode Interview Questions! 😳
summary: A DevOps YouTuber tests GitHub Copilot on a range of Leetcode problems and finds it solves most immediately, with a few needing tweaks and some far off. He concludes it would outperform him in a FAANG-style interview.
why: Cited as evidence that AI can solve interview-style algorithm puzzles, in threads questioning the value of Leetcode.
